## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle compendium of essential *karmavācanā* formulae for daily monastic use, extracted (撰出) from the *Shísòng lǜ* ([KR6k0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0016)) by **Sēng Qú** 僧璩 ([僧璩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E7%92%A9)) of the Liú-Sòng dynasty. Sēng Qú was a second-generation disciple in the Sēngyè 僧業 lineage of *Shísòng* specialists at Jiànkāng.

**Abstract**

The *Shísòng jiémó bǐqiū yàoyòng* is the **only Sarvāstivāda *karmavācanā* compendium** in the Chinese canon (parallel to the Dharmaguptaka *jiémó* compilations of Kāng Sēngkǎi [KR6k0013](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0013) and Tán Dì [KR6k0014](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0014)). Together with the parent *Shísòng lǜ*, it constituted the practical-procedural base of the *Shísòng* Vinaya school in southern China during the 5th–7th centuries. The text condenses the long *karmavācanā* sections of the parent Vinaya into a portable handbook for daily use, with the standard *uposatha*, *pravāraṇā*, robe-distribution, and *upasaṃpadā* formulae.
